newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks end up on budget reaction.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks end up on budget reaction.

text.p: COLOMBO, Nov 7 (Retuer) - Sri Lanka stocks closed higher, pushed up by small local investors who were in an upbeat mood after Wednesday's budget, brokers said.
The all share closed 2.78 points up at 620.67. Price gains led declines by 39 to 14. Lanka Orix Leasing and Mercantile Leasing rose three rupees each to 140 and 25, respectively.
"Small retail investors had a field day among low valued shares," said Dimuthu Abeysekera, a broker at Allied Phillips Securities.
The optimism created by the budget spilled over even into stocks which did not warrant an upward movement, he said.
Turnover was 58.64 million on 1.1 million shares, supported by foreign buying of 290,000 Ceylon Brewery and 172,700 Hayleys. Foreign buying was 42.9 million rupees and selling, 32.6 million.
"Hayleys has been identified as a stock with sound fundamentals, given the export incentives offered in the budget," said Sarinda Unamboowe, a trader at brokerage John Keells.
